_doc: Per-call cost ESTIMATES in USD, one key per provider SKU. The adapters read these (via budget.price); the cost_ledger refines actuals over time. Edit here, never in code. Verify against each vendor's pricing page.

_sku.millionverifier_verify: MillionVerifier API v3, 1 email verification (prepaid credit)
_sku.google_places_details: Google Places (New) Place Details, 1 call with website+phone field mask (paid SKU; basic Text Search is free)
_sku.logo: logo fetch (favicon/og:image), no external paid call
_sku.site_enrich: self-hosted page fetch, no external paid call
_sku.gemini: Gemini flash-lite generateContent, 1 call (providers/gemini.py enrich lane)
_sku.llm_cheap: cheap LLM lane (cheap_llm.py CHEAP ladder): cheapest-first per provider, 1 chat completion
_sku.llm_premium: premium LLM lane (cheap_llm.py PREMIUM ladder): the Composer / Tier-3, 1 chat completion
